messages.subject: Filtering in Shiny
parts:
This is the code I am using to import and then filter a data set in shiny

    shinyServer(function(input, output) {
          Data<-data.frame(readRDS("Data.Rds"))
          output$campaign_list<-renderUI({
            selectInput("camp_name","Select Campaign",unique(Data$Campaign))
          })
          
          data_actuals_table<-reactive({
            p_1<-Data%>%
              select(Campaign,Driver,Spend,Revenue)%>%
              filter(Campaign %in% input$camp_name)
            p_2<-p_1%>%
              select(Driver,Spend,Revenue)
            p_2[nrow(p_2)+1,]<-c("Total",sum(p_2$Spend),sum(p_2$Revenue))
            print(p_1)
          })
        })

where Campaign is a column of strings.

I am getting the following result

    [1] Campaign Driver   Spend    Revenue 
    <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
    Warning in matrix(align.tmp[(2 - pos):(ncol(x) + 1)], nrow = nrow(x), ncol = ncol(x) +  :
      data length exceeds size of matrix

Followed by the filtered result. Any help in explaining this warning message will be of great help as this empty matrix is creating obstruction

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Filtering in Shiny
parts:
In the beginning of your data_actual_table reactive, make this the first line of that reactive:

validate(need(input$camp_name, message = FALSE))

This will stop the reactive from attempting to execute unless input$camp_name is present (which it isn't when the app first loads, since that selectInput is part of a renderUI).
